# Responding to release authorities issued to SMSFs
## What is a release authority
- Division 293 tax – due and payable

## Types of release authorities
### Division 293 tax – due and payable
When an individual has a Division 293 tax due and payable debt associated with contributions made to accumulation super accounts, the debt must be paid within 21 days of the date of the notice of assessment.
